name: Facet
author: Erin Carter
description: A kaleidoscope jewel: the angle around centre is mirror-folded into N wedges and a slowly drifting FBM glow field is sampled in the folded space, producing soft luminous lobes with perfect n-fold symmetry, brightest where mirrored features kiss along the seams and fading into a near-black vignette toward the corners.

params.label: Folds
params.effect: Number of mirror wedges in the kaleidoscope; low values give broad cathedral-like sectors, high values a tight snowflake.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Speed the source glow field slides beneath the folds — directly sets how fast features merge and split at the seams.

params.label: Feature size
params.effect: Characteristic blob size of the FBM field in CSS px; small makes intricate fractured detail, large makes broad soft lobes.
